summary: OpenAI's president states the company completed a review of the Hugging Face incident and used the findings to raise its internal safety, security, and alignment standards across training and evaluation infrastructure.

practices.reason: The post references improved safety/security/alignment standards in training and evaluation infrastructure but gives no concrete method or transferable detail.
practices.quote: we've used what we've learned to drive significant upleveling in our standards for safety, security, and alignment in our training and evaluation infrastructure — not just upon deployment.
